channel.title: Mosaicage.com Living Updates
channel.description: A Turkish mosaic lamp is a handmade lamp whose shade is built by hand from hundreds of pieces of hand-cut colored glass. Switch one on and the glass scatters warm, jewel-toned light across the room. Every Mosaic Age lamp is handmade in the Turkish style, arrives with its bulb included, and ships from the USA in 2–5 days.
